export_depth_images: export depth frames from a ScanNet .sens file to PNG images with optional resizing and inpainting
export_color_images: export color frames from a ScanNet .sens file to PNG images with optional resizing
export_poses: export camera pose matrices from a ScanNet .sens file as individual text files
export_intrinsics: export camera intrinsic and extrinsic matrices from a ScanNet .sens file as text files
load_sensor_data: load a ScanNet .sens file and parse sensor metadata, compression types, and RGBD frames
